summary: Iteration 2 full-stack testing of Orby (landscape sci-fi HUD redesign + 56-expression catalogue). Backend: 22/22 pytest green (adds 4 new iteration-2 tests: test_chat_expressao_from_56_list, test_chat_hud_itens_rotulo_texto_for_explanation, test_chat_local_cerebro_intent, test_stats_endpoint; previous 18 regression tests all pass). Frontend LANDSCAPE 844x390: orby-screen, robot-face, settings-button, status-chip, mic-button, sound-toggle-button, gemini-live-button all render; status-chip toggles clock HUD on the right (hud-panel + hud-clock-time + hud-battery visible); settings-sheet -> type-message-button -> type-message-input works, send triggers thinking state showing hud-brain + all four stats (hud-stat-neural, hud-stat-internet, hud-stat-database, hud-stat-context) while awaiting Gemini, then summary panel (hud-summary-title + hud-summary-text) appears; typed 'mostra seu cérebro' -> hud-brain (local intent, confirmed by backend test_chat_local_cerebro_intent returning kind=local, hud.modo=cerebro); settings-gallery-button opens gallery-sheet with exactly 56 gallery-face-* tiles; tapping gallery-face-apaixonado closes the sheet and face-expression-apaixonado renders on the face; gemini-live-button opens gemini-live-panel inside the right HUD; portrait 390x844 keeps all core controls (orby-screen, robot-face, settings-button, mic-button, sound-toggle-button, gemini-live-button, status-chip) visible and usable with no overlap.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[Reanimated] Property [opacity] may be overwritten by a layout animation. Please wrap your component with an animated view and apply the layout animation on the wrapper.' Fires when hud panels enter/exit. Cosmetic warning only, animation plays correctly. Reference: likely in /app/frontend/src/components/hud/SummaryPanel.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/hud/BrainPanel.tsx — wrap the inner opacity-styled view with an Animated.View that owns the entering/exiting layout animation.

action_items: (Minor polish, non-blocking) Wrap the opacity-animated inner View inside SummaryPanel/BrainPanel with an outer Animated.View that owns the FadeIn/FadeOut layout animation to silence the Reanimated warning.

(Observation) The specific prompt 'Como funcionam os painéis solares...' sometimes makes Gemini return hud.texto (single paragraph) instead of hud.itens list; both shapes are supported by the frontend (hud-summary-text renders) and backend. The itens-with-rotulo path is validated by test_chat_hud_itens_rotulo_texto_for_explanation using a 'me explica em tópicos' prompt that reliably triggers itens.
(Observation, same as iter 1) After hud-close-button tap the hud-summary-title element remains in the DOM briefly due to reanimated FadeOut; UX correct, visibility toggle is immediate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: new 56-key EXPRESSION_GUIDE with human-mapping guidance in the system prompt is clean; parse_reply falls back to 'calmo' on unknown expressao — good defensive validation.

server.py: local_intent for 'mostra seu cerebro' is matched BEFORE Gemini and returns hud.modo=cerebro with kind='local' — fast + predictable; test_chat_local_cerebro_intent confirms sub-second response.
server.py: new /api/stats/{session_id} returns {memories, messages} as ints — used by frontend brain panel to drive 'conexões neurais' bar — verified via test_stats_endpoint.

index.tsx: thinkingHud ref flow (startThinking -> setHud cerebro, applyReply clears if wasThinking and no new hud) is correct, so brain panel appears while thinking and transitions cleanly to summary.
index.tsx: landscape face shift (shiftX) is computed from hudLeft/sideL/width via useSharedValue+withSpring — tested visually, face correctly shifts left when HUD opens on the right.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL throughout; no hardcoded URLs; all 15+ interactive elements expose testIDs.
